pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: give two percentages by district and year: institutional deliveries and 48 hour checks over registrations
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: SELECT T1.district, T1.year, CAST(T1.institutional_deliveries AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(NULLIF(T2.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS institutional_deliveries_percentage, CAST(T1.postnatal_check_48h AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(NULLIF(T2.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS postnatal_check_48h_percentage FROM maternal_services AS T1 INNER JOIN anc_visits AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = T2.year
